primary: pair-level stable word different from both inputs, recovered by bounded serial isolation

benefit.status: prospective; viability-calibration and paired assays pending
benefit.metric: mean intact closed-core count of isolation-confirmed genotypes
benefit.criterion: candidate mean exceeds each input mean in both development and independent confirmation panels
benefit.limitation: structural population proxy requires viability calibration before confirmed benefit

analysis.unit: distinct complete deterministic configuration; finite crossed panel
analysis.model: balanced focal and partner marginal means plus pair residual from additive fit, separately by split
analysis.interaction: all nine 2-by-2 differences of differences and strict partner-specific focal rank reversals; compare held-out signs
analysis.uncertainty: descriptive finite-panel census; no inferential confidence intervals or p-values
analysis.controls: paired near-minus-separated contrasts; all control contact violations retained
